package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.controller.v2;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper.OwnerMapper;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api.OwnerV2Api;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto.OwnerPageDto;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.service.ClinicService;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.CrossOrigin;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;

@RestController
@CrossOrigin(exposedHeaders = "errors, content-type")
@RequestMapping("/api")
public class OwnerRestControllerV2 implements OwnerV2Api {

    private final ClinicService clinicService;
    private final OwnerMapper ownerMapper;

    public OwnerRestControllerV2(ClinicService clinicService, OwnerMapper ownerMapper) {
        this.clinicService = clinicService;
        this.ownerMapper = ownerMapper;
    }

    @Override
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
    public ResponseEntity<OwnerPageDto> listOwnersPage(String lastName, Integer page, Integer size) {
        int pageNumber = page == null ? 0 : page;
        int pageSize = size == null ? 20 : size;
        Page<Owner> owners = this.clinicService.findOwners(
            lastName,
            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, pageSize, Sort.by("id")));
        return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerMapper.toOwnerPageDto(owners), HttpStatus.OK);
    }
}

## Summary

I implemented idempotent owner creation in `OwnerRestControllerV1` (the controller behind `POST /api/owners`).

**What changed** in `src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

1. **Read the header without changing the generated API signature.** `addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` is an `@Override` of the OpenAPI-generated `OwnersApi`, so I couldn't add a `@RequestHeader` parameter. Instead I inject a Spring request-scoped `HttpServletRequest` via the constructor and read `Idempotency-Key` from it.

2. **Idempotency store.** A static `ConcurrentHashMap<String, Integer>` (`IDEMPOTENT_CREATES`) remembers which owner id each seen key produced.

3. **Create flow.** `addOwner` now:
   - If a non-blank `Idempotency-Key` is present and already mapped to an owner that still exists, it returns that owner rendered the same way `getOwner` does (household member count + bulk-signup warning) with **200 OK** — no duplicate created.
   - Otherwise it runs the normal create pipeline (returning **201 Created** with the `Location` header as before), and records `key → new owner id` when a key was supplied.

A blank/absent key behaves exactly as before. The lookup tolerates a key pointing at an owner that no longer exists (e.g. rolled back) by falling through to a normal create.

The acceptance test `coreIdempotentRepeat` — which posts the same owner twice with one key and asserts the second call returns 200 with the same id — passes, as does the full build.
